title: 3 Inch Cabinet Pull In Solid Brass | Satin Brass | Cabinet Hardware Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Refresh bathroom cabinetry with a small upgrade that makes drawers and cabinet doors easier to use and look more finished in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. This 3 inch cabinet pull coordinates with the Cabinet Hardware collection for a cohesive, transitional feel.

  • Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Built for lasting use: crafted from solid brass construction.
